[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Janet Glasgow was born on 21 October 1796, according to the indexed Kirknewton and East Calder parish-register transcript. It names her father as John Glasgow and her mother as “Margt Meikle” and gives the family residence as Ormiston.<ref name="FMP-4478163">[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4478163&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929, Janet Glasgow, birth 21 October 1796, Kirknewton & East Calder, Midlothian, OPR 690/3, item 2, page 44; transcript inspected, original register image not inspected.]</ref> The recorded parents are consistent with her existing [[Glasgow-1304|John Glasgow]] and [[Muckle-67|Margaret Muckle]] family, although the transcript’s “Meikle” surname has not yet been reconciled against the original entry or the held “Muckle” citation.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1304]] is assessed at 94% (proved). The earlier assessment summarized the held FamilySearch birth/baptism citation as associating Janet “before 1796” at Kirknewton with John Glasgow and Margaret Muckle; that approximate date wording is superseded by the 21 October 1796 birth stated in the Findmypast transcript. The paired mother, locality and ordered 1796–1814 children identify the existing adult household; the early Janet fits the opening of the Muckle child sequence.

Whole selected father-profile proposition; maternity and upstream ancestry assessed separately.

Next useful test: Inspect this child’s OPR entry alongside the Muckle sibling sequence.

The Findmypast transcript distinguishes her birth on 21 October 1796 from its blank baptism field. The previously recorded “before 6 November 1796” birth bound is consistent with that date, but 6 November is not established here as a baptism. “Ormiston” is recorded as residence, not an exact birthplace. The original OPR page and the held FamilySearch citation should be compared before treating the Meikle/Muckle spellings as proven identical. The father’s existing 94% assessment is retained; this date refinement does not independently regrade maternity or ancestry.<ref name="FMP-4478163" />

=== Later derivative baptism review, 24 October 2026 ===

A further Findmypast OPR 690/3 item 2 transcript, page 13, explicitly distinguishes Janet Glasgow’s birth on 21 October 1796 from baptism on 6 November 1796 in Kirknewton and East Calder. It names father John Glasgow (occupation “Servt”), mother “Margt” without a surname, and gives residence literally as “?”.<ref name="FMP-1305-baptism">[https://findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4476992&tab=this Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929'', Janet Glasgow, OPR 690/3, item 2, page 13; birth 21 October and baptism 6 November 1796; provider derivative transcript inspected, original image uninspected.]</ref> Two companion indexes repeat the 6 November baptism and name the mother “Margaret Muckle Or Meikle”; one assigns Kirknewton residence.<ref name="FMP-1305-companions">[https://findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_686210501&tab=this Findmypast companion index, Janet Glasgow, baptism 6 November 1796, Kirknewton and East Calder, parents John Glasgow and Margaret Muckle Or Meikle]; [https://findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_691905239&tab=this second companion index]. Derivative transcripts inspected; originals uninspected.</ref> These are companions of the same likely child event, not independent proof of three baptisms. The earlier inspected transcript, OPR 690/3 item 2 page 44, supplied the same birth date but left baptism blank, gave “Margt Meikle” and Ormiston residence.<ref name="FMP-4478163" /> Thus the earlier note that its blank field did not establish 6 November remains true of that source alone; the new page 13 transcript expressly supplies the baptism date. The page numbers and residence readings differ and require original-register comparison. The Muckle/Meikle surname variation and identification of the named parents with the adult profiles remain qualified; the existing 94% father grade is unchanged.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4K-2MB?from=lynx1UIV8&treeref=M2Q3-T2J https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4K-2MB?from=lynx1UIV8&treeref=M2Q3-T2J]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
